newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Amato urges study of ENEL/Deutsche bid.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Amato urges study of ENEL/Deutsche bid.

text.p: The proposed bid by Italian electricity utility ENEL and Deutsche Telekom for the third mobile telephone licence in Italy should be examined by an anti-trust authority, the head of Italy's anti-trust authority Giuliano Amato said on Monday.
This examination could be by anti-trust authorities in either Rome or Brussels, he added in a statement.

This followed criticism over the possible entry of ENEL/Deutsche Telekom into Italy's mobile phone market by Vito Gamberale, the managing director of Italy's leading mobile phone group Telecom Italia Mobile (TIM) earlier on Monday.

The chief executive of Olivetti Roberto Colaninno, which is the majority shareholder in second mobile phone operator Omnitel has also criticised the possible entry of the state-owned company ENEL into the mobile telephone field.
